svg.aria-label: Someone is reading your profile. PERCEPTION: A visitor. Eyes on the commit graph. Act natural. ENCYCLOPEDIA: Deimos: the smaller of Mars' two moons, a dozen kilometres of rock named for dread. Also you: a data science student at Sakarya University. LOGIC: 478 contributions in the last year, 89 active days. Not a drip, a flood: October alone took 253. INLAND EMPIRE: The games are listening to the data. Or the data is learning to play. Hard to say who started it. ELECTROCHEMISTRY: One more commit, then sleep. It will not be one. VOLITION: The streak is broken. Best was 11. Get up. Push something.
